bayts.text: And grant me today, in my habits, and after it, the gifts of the masters.
And write for me today and after it good pleasure in all the aims; reward the purpose for me with thanks.
Make my creeds dwell in the affirmation of Oneness, and revive through me the way of the Unique (Prophet).
And make the word upright and illumine the heart, O Sender-down, Who bestowed the sūras on me.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You granted me, on the day of my writing this (poem), pearls and rubies that perpetuated (precious) fragments.
Accept from me gratitude for Your noble Countenance, O You Whose favours with me shall not depart,
by Your blessing and Your greeting with peace, on my behalf, him through whom I am vaunted over the learned.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make my writing through him, O Appreciative, O You toward Whom gratitude from me has turned,
gratitude, guidance, sainthood and good pleasure, O You Who protected me from enemies and sickness,
in every month; and make the months for me acts of worship that have contained (bridal) dowries.
And make my writings with You, O Beautiful (Al-Jamīl), Your highest good pleasure, that does not swerve from You.
To Your noble Countenance my writing has already turned, O You with Whom it has been extolled.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have made me proceed with the Truth, possessed of certainty; (from) all that You did not approve for me, protect me.
Bear witness for me to my veneration of Your noble Countenance, together with the Book and Your noble Prophet.
And bless on my behalf forever, with peace, him who made me inherit the best speech.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me truthfulness with fidelity, and spare me the breaking (of pacts) and harshness.
You have turned to me in forgiveness: so perpetuate for me righteousness, steadfastness and the most beneficial success.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have brought my journey to You to its end through the Chosen, and led Your grace to me unto the Gardens.
And You have guarded my secret for me in the two Abodes, as You protected me from the two disgraces.
Bless with peace, without end, the son of ʿAbd Allāh, possessed of splendour.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And guard the Remembrance through me, and return to me all You chose for me, with Your good pleasure, O All-Hearing.
And guard my heart, my tongue and my hand unto the Gardens, Everlasting One, with what most benefits.
And show me the realities of things, O Giver of gifts of dwellings and shades.
And make my edifice pure for Your Countenance, O One, Whose likeness there is not.
You have conveyed to me today, before today and after it, a secret that protected from blame.
I have renewed the abandoning of relapse (into sin) for veneration, and You have been for me with prose and verse.
Fulfil for me hope in my leaving and in my taking, without breach and without what terrifies.
Fulfil for me hope in every refuge, and make my life, from You, the finest of favours.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
Reward with thanks, teach, bless, answer, and benefit with what lasts, the loftiest marvel.
And bless on my behalf forever and grant peace upon my means of access, the intercessor, the ladder.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And raise, by the right of Your noble Countenance, my writing to You with honour.
And with You make it the most exalted good, without end, and make my provisions eternal.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have brought into being for me what is not seen for others than me, in You and in the Qurʾān, the vessel of good,
and in Your Prophet and Your servant, the Messenger, him through whom You convey to me from You the best request.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And banish Iblīs through him with a banishing that does not depart, toward other than my person, O Guardian (Al-Ḥafīẓ), O Generous.
And with You make me possessed of righteousness, without contention, with success.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have protected me today and after today from the devils and from all blame.
Bless with peace, without end, on my behalf, him who led knowledge to me.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
